title: How expensive is switching?
hook: Each completed task chunk pays its stated switch cost within a 30-minute budget.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to calculate a stipulated switching budget without treating the cost as a universal cognitive constant

misconception: Holding calendar time fixed guarantees the same completed work despite switching overhead.
objective: Calculate a stipulated switching budget without treating the cost as a universal cognitive constant.

claims.text: Original stipulated toy: Every task chunk includes its own switch overhead; time cannot overlap; no partial chunks; zero automatic inference about real multitasking. Short switches allow {A}; longer switches {B}. The larger overhead leaves room for fewer complete task chunks.
